tutorial: Install SEGGER J-Link 7.88j. Connect SWDIO, SWCLK and GND; power the board at 2.7-3.6 V. Follow the board wiring guide.
Choose a Full ZIP (App, Recovery, S112 and GUI), then the board marking. OTA ZIPs and standalone Apps are not Full images.

After Full and board validation, confirm complete flashing first (default No). Only then will the tool wait for a USB probe and target, verify identity and write. Ordinary settings and image indexes will be reset.
While waiting, press Q or Esc to cancel. Other menus accept an empty answer to cancel. Errors remain visible until you press a key.
en.invalidFirmware: Invalid firmware number; select a listed Full ZIP.
en.browseFirmware: No acceptable Full ZIP beside the tools. Choose a Full ZIP in the file dialog.
en.noBoards: No supplied supported board configurations in native-configs. Restore the complete tools directory.
en.selectBoard: Select the board marking and supplied panel configuration:
en.invalidBoard: Invalid board number; select a listed board configuration.
en.waitingProbe: Waiting for J-Link USB probe; connect it now. Q/Esc cancels.
en.waitingTarget: Waiting for powered nRF52811 target on SWD; check wiring. Q/Esc cancels.
en.preservation: Preservation: attempt usable original information; missing records use defaults.
en.scope: Full initialization clears ordinary settings, QR/labels, health/crash records and old image heads.
en.warning: Image pixels are not securely erased. FICR/UICR and external reserved sectors are skipped.

tutorial: 先安装 SEGGER J-Link 7.88j。按主板接线图连接 SWDIO、SWCLK、GND，并给主板提供 2.7–3.6 V 电源。
先选包含 App、Recovery、S112 和 GUI 的 Full ZIP，再选主板丝印；OTA 包或单独 App 不能用于完整刷机。
校验完整固件和主板后，先确认是否完整刷机（默认否）；同意后才等待 USB 探针及目标设备，校验身份并写入。普通设置和图片索引将重建。
等待时按 Q 或 Esc 取消；其他选择留空可取消。结束或报错后，按任意键关闭窗口。
